author_claim: Pheromone-bound MUP-I is rigid between residues 3 and 158 on the ps-ns scale; only Ala160 and terminal Glu162 are highly flexible. Flexibility on the fast time scale is slightly higher than in the free protein, strongest in loops C-D and G-H, the region between the long helix and strand I, and before the C-terminal 3-10 helix; 40% of residues have RCI below -0.5 and 7% above 0.5.
anchor: showed that the backbone flexibility on the fast time scale is slightly increased upon pheromone binding

caveat_note: Entry card lists 283, 288, 298, 303, 308 K (600 MHz) and 291, 297, 302 K (500 MHz) without 293 K, which fits the free protein (the free-protein 293 K, 14.1 T data were excluded) and the card names no ligand; so the deposit is probably the free protein. Per-residue a0 and tau1 are given only as figure plots (Figures 4 and 5), so no per-residue values are in the row. The authors note a0 here is about 0.1 higher than in their 1999 study and the source of the difference is unclear; a0 changes upon binding are small. T* is above 450 K for most residues (190 K for Glu162).
